The '''Taung''' were an ancient [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] of the [[Core Worlds]] [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. The [[Standard day|day]] of [[Taungsday]] was named for the species.<ref name="Falcon 61" /> The [[beskad]], a traditional [[Mandalorian]] [[sword]], was based on an ancient Taung design.<ref name="COTR">''[[Collapse of the Republic]]''</ref> The [[Taung & Zhell Society]], a student group at the [[University of Coruscant]], shared its name with the species.<ref name="Rebel Files">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Taung were first mentioned in the new ''Star Wars'' [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 61|sixty-first issue]] of ''[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon]]'',<ref name="Falcon 61" /> published around [[March 2]], [[2016]].<ref name="BMFdate">{{BMFdates|61}}</ref>

In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the [[Taung/Legends|Taung]], who were first mentioned in the liner notes for the [[Shadows of the Empire (soundtrack)|''Shadows of the Empire'' soundtrack]],<ref name="SotE">[[Shadows of the Empire (soundtrack)|''Shadows of the Empire'' soundtrack]] liner notes</ref> and the original [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Species/Legends|species]], who first appeared in the [[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 1|first issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series,<ref name="TOTJ">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 1]]</ref> were revealed to be one and the same in the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' article "[[The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors|The History of the Mandalorians]]." That article elaborated on the Taung as the precursors of the Mandalorian culture.<ref name="History of the Mandalorians">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref>
